title: Brand Standard on Relocated Room Reservations
content:
When a hotel cannot provide a guaranteed Room Reservations reservation on the arrival date, it relocates the guest to a comparable hotel nearby. Relocation is recorded by the hotel; guest services never relocates a reservation and adds no compensation beyond these rules.

## What follows a relocation

| Matter | Position |
|---|---|
| Cancellation penalty or no-show charge | Never charged on a relocated reservation |
| First night at the alternate hotel | Paid by the hotel directly when the plan provides for it; that payment does not pass through the guest's records |
| Prepayments and advance deposits held | Refunded in full when the plan provides for it |
| Points redeemed | Returned in full |
| Free Night Awards applied | Released back to the member's account |
| Relocation compensation points | Posted under the Ashbury Rewards relocation compensation rule when the reservation carries an Ashbury Rewards membership and the plan makes the member eligible |

## Points of judgement

- **Compensation without a membership.** Relocation compensation points need an Ashbury Rewards membership on the reservation; without one, none are posted.
- **Further compensation requested.** Guest services adds no compensation beyond these rules.
- **The alternate hotel's first night on the guest's folio.** That payment does not pass through the guest's records when the hotel pays it directly.
